name: Midnight Arsonist
oracle_text: When this creature enters, destroy up to X target artifacts without mana abilities, where X is the number of Vampires you control.
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, destroy up to X target artifacts without mana abilities, where X is the number of Vampires you control.

needs.what: a selector key (e.g. `has_mana_ability: false`) matching permanents by whether they have a mana ability, so a target spec can say "artifacts without mana abilities"; it must read the permanent's current abilities, granted ones included
needs.why_existing_wont_do: selector_keys has nothing that asks about an object's abilities: `ability_kind` is legal only on an `ability_on_stack` target, `not_keywords` covers keywords only, and `any_mana_ability` exists only under `tapped_permanent_keys` for mana-ability riders. The rest of the line is expressible: a self_enters trigger with a permanent target `count: {count: {controller: you, subtypes: [Vampire], zone: battlefield}}, up_to: true` (trigger target counts may be value expressions, per targeting.target_count) and a `destroy` op
